    Keyboard shortcuts

    Use Cmd instead of Ctrl on macOS.

    Shortcut Action
    Arrow keys Move the active cell.
    Shift+Arrow keys Extend the selection.
    Tab / Shift+Tab Move right/left and wrap at row boundaries.
    Enter / Shift+Enter Move down/up; commit first when editing.
    Home / End Move to the first/last column in the row.
    Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End Move to the first/last cell in the table.
    Page Up / Page Down Move by approximately one visible page.
    F2 or double-click Edit the existing cell value.
    Typing Replace the active cell and begin editing.
    Esc Cancel editing or close search.
    Delete / Backspace Clear cells or remove selected rows/columns.
    Ctrl+S Save.
    Ctrl+Z Undo.
    Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y Redo.
    Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V Copy / cut / paste.
    Ctrl+A Select the entire editable grid.
    Ctrl+F Open search.
    F3 / Shift+F3 Select the next / previous search match.

    During an edit started with F2 or a double-click, arrow keys move the caret. During an edit started by typing, arrow keys commit the value and move to the adjacent cell.
